INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
(
    master_run_id,
    master_pipeline_nm,
    trigger_type_cd,
    run_type_override_cd,
    run_param,
    child_total_cnt,
    child_succ_cnt,
    child_fail_cnt,
    status,
    created_by
)
VALUES
(
    '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
    'MANUAL',
    'REQUEST',
    '{"request_src":"ETL_SIGNAL"}'::jsonb,
    0, 0, 0,
    'RUNNING',
    'ADF'
)
ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING;

-- ============================================================
-- SCR_PREPARE_SIGNAL
--
-- 지원 유형 : FULL, INCR, INCR_SQL
-- 제외 유형 : PRVDEL_*
--
-- 제외 유형은 NEW 상태 유지
--
-- Source : DB2 / MSSQL
-- DB2    : WITH UR
-- MSSQL  : WITH (NOLOCK)
--
-- 중복 방지 : signal_id UNIQUE
-- ============================================================

WITH signal_src AS
(
    SELECT
        s.signal_id,
        s.src_db_nm,
        s.src_schema_nm,
        s.src_table_nm,
        s.load_type,
        s.load_method,
        s.load_col,
        s.frequency,
        s."interval" AS interval_n,
        s.load_from,
        s.load_to,
        s.sql_file_nm,

        m.target_cnt,
        m.target_id,
        m.src_type,
        m.master_schema_nm,
        m.master_table_nm,
        m.init_wait_yn

    FROM adfadm.etl_signal s

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL
    (
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS target_cnt,
            MIN(t.target_id) AS target_id,
            MIN(t.src_type) AS src_type,
            MIN(t.src_schema_nm) AS master_schema_nm,
            MIN(t.src_table_nm) AS master_table_nm,
            MIN(t.init_wait_yn) AS init_wait_yn

        FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master t

        WHERE UPPER(t.src_db_nm) = UPPER(s.src_db_nm)
          AND UPPER(t.src_schema_nm) = UPPER(s.src_schema_nm)
          AND UPPER(t.src_table_nm) = UPPER(s.src_table_nm)
          AND t.data_class = 'RAW'
          AND t.delete_yn = 'N'

    ) m ON TRUE

    WHERE s.status = 'NEW'

      -- 수집 대상 : FULL / INCR / INCR_SQL
      AND s.load_type IN ('FULL', 'INCR','INCR_SQL')

      -- 기존 수집 이력에 등록된 Signal 제외
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run p
          WHERE p.signal_id = s.signal_id
      )

    ORDER BY s.signal_id
    LIMIT 100

    -- 동시 Polling 실행에서 같은 Signal 선점 방지
    FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
),

-- ============================================================
-- 1. 검증
-- ============================================================
validated AS
(
    SELECT
        s.*,

        CASE
            WHEN target_cnt = 0
                THEN 'TARGET_NOT_REGISTERED'

            WHEN target_cnt > 1
                THEN 'MULTIPLE_TARGETS_FOUND'

            WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(src_type, ''))
                 NOT IN ('DB2', 'MSSQL')
                THEN 'UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_TYPE'

            -- FULL은 초기 수집 대기 여부와 관계없이 허용
            -- INCR / INCR_SQL은 초기 수집 완료 필요
            WHEN load_type IN ('INCR', 'INCR_SQL')
             AND init_wait_yn = 'Y'
                THEN 'INITIAL_LOAD_REQUIRED'

            -- FULL 적재방식
            WHEN load_type = 'FULL'
             AND load_method <> 'truncate_insert'
                THEN 'INVALID_LOAD_METHOD'


            -- INCR 적재방식
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR_SQL'
             AND load_method NOT IN
             (
                 'insert_only',
                 'upsert'
             )
                THEN 'INVALID_INCR_SQL_LOAD_METHOD'

            -- INCR 적재방식
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND load_method NOT IN
             (
                 'insert_only',
                 'range_delete_insert',
                 'upsert'
             )
                THEN 'INVALID_LOAD_METHOD'
     
            -- INCR_SQL은 SQL 파일명 필수 (경로는 별도 조합)
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR_SQL'
             AND NULLIF(BTRIM(sql_file_nm), '') IS NULL
                THEN 'SQL_FILE_NAME_REQUIRED'

            -- 증분 조건
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND
             (
                 COALESCE(TRIM(load_col), '') = ''
                 OR COALESCE(frequency, '')
                    NOT IN ('DAY', 'WEEK', 'MONTH')
                 OR COALESCE(interval_n, 0) < 1
                 OR load_from IS NULL
                 OR (
                     load_to IS NOT NULL
                     AND load_to <= load_from
                 )
             )
                THEN 'INVALID_INCR_RANGE'

            -- MONTH는 YYYYMM 단위 비교
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND frequency = 'MONTH'
             AND load_to IS NOT NULL
             AND TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM')
                 >= TO_CHAR(load_to, 'YYYYMM')
                THEN 'INVALID_MONTH_RANGE'

            -- RANGE_DELETE_INSERT
            -- DAY/WEEK는 날짜 경계(자정)만 지원
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND load_method = 'range_delete_insert'
             AND frequency IN ('DAY', 'WEEK')
             AND
             (
                 load_from::time <> TIME '00:00:00'
                 OR (
                     load_to IS NOT NULL
                     AND load_to::time <> TIME '00:00:00'
                 )
             )
                THEN 'INVALID_RANGE_TIME_BOUNDARY'

            -- SQL 식별자 검증
            WHEN COALESCE(src_db_nm, '')
                 !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'

              OR COALESCE(master_schema_nm, '')
                 !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'

              OR COALESCE(master_table_nm, '')
                 !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'

              OR
              (
                  load_type = 'INCR'
                  AND COALESCE(load_col, '')
                      !~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'
              )
                THEN 'INVALID_IDENTIFIER'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS error_code

    FROM signal_src s
),

-- ============================================================
-- 2. DBMS별 식별자 / 경로 정보
-- ============================================================
resolved AS
(
    SELECT
        v.*,

        UPPER(src_type) AS dbms_type,

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(src_type) = 'MSSQL'
            THEN '[' || master_schema_nm || ']'
            ELSE UPPER(master_schema_nm)
        END AS sql_schema_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(src_type) = 'MSSQL'
            THEN '[' || master_table_nm || ']'
            ELSE UPPER(master_table_nm)
        END AS sql_table_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type <> 'INCR'
            THEN NULL

            WHEN UPPER(src_type) = 'MSSQL'
            THEN '[' || load_col || ']'

            ELSE UPPER(load_col)
        END AS sql_column_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'FULL' THEN 'full'
            ELSE 'incr'
        END AS path_type,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'FULL' THEN 'daily'
            -- 파일 기반 수집은 주기 미지정 시 landing 경로에 daily 사용
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR_SQL' AND frequency IS NULL THEN 'daily'
            WHEN frequency = 'DAY' THEN 'daily'
            WHEN frequency = 'WEEK' THEN 'weekly'
            WHEN frequency = 'MONTH' THEN 'monthly'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS frequency_nm,

        TIMEZONE(
            'Asia/Seoul',
            statement_timestamp()
        ) AS batch_dt

    FROM validated v
),

-- ============================================================
-- 3. 증분 추출 WHERE 조건
--
-- load_from / load_to 그대로 사용
-- interval_n 재계산하지 않음
-- ============================================================
range_sql AS
(
    SELECT
        r.*,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type <> 'INCR'
            THEN NULL

            -- MONTH : YYYYMM
            WHEN frequency = 'MONTH'
            THEN format(
                '%s >= %L',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM')
            )

            -- DB2 : TIMESTAMP
            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
            THEN format(
                '%s >= TIMESTAMP(%L)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(
                    load_from,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24.MI.SS'
                )
            )

            -- MSSQL : datetime2
            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
            THEN format(
                '%s >= CONVERT(datetime2, %L, 126)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(
                    load_from,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'
                )
            )

        END AS from_condition,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type <> 'INCR'
              OR load_to IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN frequency = 'MONTH'
            THEN format(
                '%s < %L',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(load_to, 'YYYYMM')
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
            THEN format(
                '%s < TIMESTAMP(%L)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(
                    load_to,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24.MI.SS'
                )
            )

            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
            THEN format(
                '%s < CONVERT(datetime2, %L, 126)',
                sql_column_nm,
                TO_CHAR(
                    load_to,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'
                )
            )
        END AS to_condition

    FROM resolved r
),

-- ============================================================
-- 4. 추출 SQL / 파일 경로 / 파일명
-- ============================================================
prepared AS
(
    SELECT
        r.*,

        LOWER(
            'pl_raw_ingest_'
            || dbms_type
            || '_'
            || src_db_nm
        ) AS child_pipeline_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN NULL

             WHEN load_type = 'INCR_SQL'
             THEN s.src_db_nm || '/'
             || s.src_schema_nm || '/'
             || s.src_table_nm || '/'
             || s.load_type || '/' 
             || s.sql_file_nm

            -- DB2 FULL
            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
             AND load_type = 'FULL'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WITH UR',
                sql_schema_nm,
                sql_table_nm
            )

            -- MSSQL FULL
            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
             AND load_type = 'FULL'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WITH (NOLOCK)',
                sql_schema_nm,
                sql_table_nm
            )

            -- DB2 INCR
            WHEN dbms_type = 'DB2'
             AND load_type = 'INCR'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WHERE %s WITH UR',
                sql_schema_nm,
                sql_table_nm,
                CONCAT_WS(
                    ' AND ',
                    from_condition,
                    to_condition
                )
            )

            -- MSSQL INCR
            WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
             AND load_type = 'INCR'
            THEN format(
                'SELECT * FROM %s.%s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE %s',
                sql_schema_nm,
                sql_table_nm,
                CONCAT_WS(
                    ' AND ',
                    from_condition,
                    to_condition
                )
            )
        END AS final_extract_query,

        -- Container = ingest
        -- landing_path에는 컨테이너명 제외
        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN NULL

            ELSE format(
                '%s/frequency=%s/batch_datetime=%s/',
                path_type,
                frequency_nm,
                TO_CHAR(batch_dt, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI')
            )
        END AS final_landing_path,

        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL
            THEN NULL

            ELSE format(
                '%s.%s.%s.default.%s.parquet',
                UPPER(src_db_nm),
                UPPER(master_schema_nm),
                UPPER(master_table_nm),
                TO_CHAR(batch_dt, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
            )
        END AS final_file_name

    FROM range_sql r
),

-- ============================================================
-- 5. DBX 적재방식 및 범위 메타
-- ============================================================
range_meta AS
(
    SELECT
        p.*,

        -- DBX 적재 방식
        CASE p.load_method
            WHEN 'truncate_insert'
                THEN 'FULL_DELETE_INSERT'

            WHEN 'insert_only'
                THEN 'INSERT_ONLY'

            WHEN 'upsert'
                THEN 'UPSERT'

            WHEN 'range_delete_insert'
                THEN 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_load_method_cd,

        -- 삭제 범위 기준 컬럼
        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND load_method = 'range_delete_insert'
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN dbms_type = 'MSSQL'
                    THEN load_col
                    ELSE UPPER(load_col)
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_range_column_nm,

        -- 삭제 범위 연산자
        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'INCR'
             AND load_method = 'range_delete_insert'
            THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN load_to IS NULL
                        THEN '>='
                    ELSE 'BETWEEN'
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_range_operator_cd,

        -- 삭제 범위 값 (JSONB 배열)
        CASE
            -- RANGE_DELETE_INSERT 이외에는 NULL
            WHEN load_type <> 'INCR'
              OR load_method <> 'range_delete_insert'
            THEN NULL

            -- --------------------------------------------
            -- MONTH : YYYYMM
            -- --------------------------------------------
            WHEN frequency = 'MONTH'
            THEN
                CASE
                    -- 종료 조건 없음
                    WHEN load_to IS NULL
                    THEN jsonb_build_array(
                        TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM')
                    )

                    -- 종료월 미포함
                    ELSE jsonb_build_array(
                        TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMM'),

                        TO_CHAR(
                            DATE_TRUNC('month', load_to)
                            - INTERVAL '1 month',
                            'YYYYMM'
                        )
                    )
                END

            -- --------------------------------------------
            -- DAY / WEEK : YYYYMMDD
            -- --------------------------------------------
            WHEN frequency IN ('DAY', 'WEEK')
            THEN
                CASE
                    -- 종료 조건 없음
                    WHEN load_to IS NULL
                    THEN jsonb_build_array(
                        TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    )

                    -- 종료일 미포함
                    ELSE jsonb_build_array(
                        TO_CHAR(load_from, 'YYYYMMDD'),

                        TO_CHAR(
                            DATE_TRUNC('day', load_to)
                            - INTERVAL '1 day',
                            'YYYYMMDD'
                        )
                    )
                END

            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_range_value

    FROM prepared p
),


-- ============================================================
-- 6. 최종 검증
-- ============================================================
ready AS
(
    SELECT
        r.*,

        CASE
            WHEN error_code IS NOT NULL
                THEN error_code

            WHEN final_load_method_cd IS NULL
                THEN 'INVALID_LOAD_METHOD'

            WHEN load_type <> 'INCR_SQL'
             AND final_extract_query IS NULL
                THEN 'EXTRACT_QUERY_NOT_GENERATED'

            WHEN final_landing_path IS NULL
              OR final_file_name IS NULL
                THEN 'GEN2_PATH_NOT_GENERATED'

            WHEN LENGTH(child_pipeline_nm) > 200
                THEN 'PIPELINE_NAME_TOO_LONG'

            WHEN LENGTH(final_file_name) > 200
                THEN 'FILE_NAME_TOO_LONG'

            WHEN LENGTH(final_landing_path) > 500
                THEN 'LANDING_PATH_TOO_LONG'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS final_error_code

    FROM range_meta r
),

-- ============================================================
-- 7. 기존 Child 실행 이력 INSERT
--
-- ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 재사용
-- signal_id UNIQUE로 중복 방지
-- ============================================================
claimed AS
(
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        signal_id,
        master_run_id,
        target_id,

        ingest_pipeline_nm,

        run_type_cd,
        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,

        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,

        incr_policy_id,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        incr_to_val,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        init_wait_yn,
        status,
        created_by
    )
    SELECT
        r.signal_id,
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        r.target_id,

        r.child_pipeline_nm,

         CASE
            WHEN r.load_type = 'INCR_SQL' THEN 'INCR'
            ELSE r.load_type
        END as load_type,
        'GEN2',
        r.final_load_method_cd,

        r.final_range_column_nm,
        r.final_range_operator_cd,
        r.final_range_value,

        -- 기존 Target Master 증분 정책 미사용
        NULL,

        CASE
            WHEN r.load_type = 'INCR'
            THEN r.load_col
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN r.load_type = 'INCR'
            THEN r.load_from::text
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN r.load_type = 'INCR'
            THEN r.load_to::text
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        r.src_type,
        r.src_db_nm,
        r.master_schema_nm,
        r.master_table_nm,
        'RAW',

        r.final_extract_query,
        r.final_landing_path,
        r.final_file_name,

        r.init_wait_yn,
        'PENDING',
        'ADF'

    FROM ready r
    WHERE r.final_error_code IS NULL

    ON CONFLICT (signal_id)
    WHERE signal_id IS NOT NULL
    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    landing_path,
    file_name,
    extract_query,
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    signal_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    run_type_cd AS load_type
),

signal_pending AS
(
    UPDATE adfadm.etl_signal s
       SET status     = 'PENDING',
           error_msg  = NULL,
           updated_dt = LOCALTIMESTAMP
      FROM claimed c
     WHERE s.signal_id = c.signal_id
       AND s.status = 'NEW'

    RETURNING s.signal_id
),

-- ============================================================
-- 8. FULL/INCR/INCR_SQL 중 검증 실패 Signal만 FAILED
--
-- PRVDEL_*은 signal_src에서 제외됐으므로
-- 상태 변경되지 않음
-- ============================================================
rejected AS
(
    UPDATE adfadm.etl_signal s

    SET
        status = 'FAILED',
        error_msg = LEFT(
            r.final_error_code,
            2000
        ),
        updated_dt = LOCALTIMESTAMP

    FROM ready r

    WHERE s.signal_id = r.signal_id
      AND s.status = 'NEW'
      AND r.final_error_code IS NOT NULL

    RETURNING s.signal_id
),

-- ============================================================
-- 9. Master 초기 건수 집계
-- ============================================================
counts AS
(
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM claimed)
            AS claimed_cnt,

        (SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM rejected)
            AS rejected_cnt
),

master_updated AS
(
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
    SET
        child_total_cnt = c.claimed_cnt,
        child_succ_cnt = 0,
        child_fail_cnt = 0,

        run_param =
            COALESCE(m.run_param, '{}'::jsonb)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'request_src', 'ETL_SIGNAL',
                'claimed_cnt', c.claimed_cnt,
                'rejected_cnt', c.rejected_cnt
            ),

        status = CASE
            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0
             AND c.rejected_cnt = 0
                THEN 'SKIPPED'

            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0
             AND c.rejected_cnt > 0
                THEN 'FAILED'

            ELSE 'RUNNING'
        END,

        skip_reason_cd = CASE
            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0
             AND c.rejected_cnt = 0
                THEN 'ETC'
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        end_dt = CASE
            WHEN c.claimed_cnt = 0
            THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        error_log = CASE
            WHEN c.rejected_cnt > 0
            THEN 'SIGNAL_VALIDATION_FAILED: '
                 || c.rejected_cnt::text
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        updated_by = 'ADF',
        updated_dt = NOW()

    FROM counts c

    WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'

    RETURNING m.master_run_id
)

-- ============================================================
-- 10. ADF ForEach 실행 파라미터 반환
--
-- 신규 INSERT된 Child만 반환
-- ============================================================
SELECT
    c.ingest_pipeline_nm,
    c.landing_path,
    c.file_name,
    c.extract_query,
    c.ingest_pipeline_id,
    c.master_run_id,
    c.signal_id,
    s.load_type,

    s.src_db_nm || '/'
        || s.src_schema_nm || '/'
        || s.src_table_nm || '/'
        || s.load_type AS sql_directory,

    s.sql_file_nm

FROM claimed c
JOIN adfadm.etl_signal s
  ON s.signal_id = c.signal_id
CROSS JOIN master_updated m

ORDER BY c.signal_id;

/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

-- =====================================================
-- ETL Signal 상태 업데이트
--
-- Child SUCCEEDED → Signal DONE
-- Child FAILED    → Signal FAILED
-- PENDING/RUNNING  → 변경하지 않음
-- =====================================================

UPDATE adfadm.etl_signal s
SET
    status = CASE
        WHEN p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'DONE'
        WHEN p.status = 'FAILED'    THEN 'FAILED'
    END,

    error_msg = CASE
        WHEN p.status = 'FAILED'
        THEN LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(p.error_log, ''),
                'ADF_INGEST_FAILED'
            ),
            2000
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END

FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run p

WHERE s.signal_id = p.signal_id
  AND p.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
  AND p.signal_id IS NOT NULL
  AND p.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')
  AND s.status = 'PENDING';

WITH signal_base AS (
    SELECT
        signal_id,
        load_type,
        frequency,
        "interval",

        '`bronze`.`'
            || REPLACE(src_schema_nm, '`', '``')
            || '`.`'
            || REPLACE(src_table_nm, '`', '``')
            || '`' AS target_table,

        '`'
            || REPLACE(load_col, '`', '``')
            || '`' AS target_col,

        '`bronze`.`'
            || REPLACE(del_lookup_schema_nm, '`', '``')
            || '`.`'
            || REPLACE(del_lookup_table_nm, '`', '``')
            || '`' AS lookup_table,

        '`'
            || REPLACE(del_lookup_col_nm, '`', '``')
            || '`' AS lookup_col

    FROM adfadm.etl_signal
    WHERE status = 'NEW'
      AND load_method = 'delete_only'
      AND load_type IN (
          'PRVDEL_DURATION',
          'PRVDEL_IDENTITY',
          'PRVDEL_SQL'
      )


    -- 동시 실행 시 다른 실행이 확보한 시그널은 건너뜀
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),
generated AS (
    SELECT
        signal_id,

        CASE
            WHEN load_type = 'PRVDEL_DURATION' THEN
                'DELETE FROM ' || target_table
                || ' WHERE ' || target_col || ' < '
                || CASE frequency
                    WHEN 'DAY' THEN
                        'DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), '
                        || "interval"::text || ')'

                    WHEN 'WEEK' THEN
                        'DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), '
                        || ("interval"::bigint * 7)::text || ')'

                    WHEN 'MONTH' THEN
                        'ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE(), -'
                        || "interval"::text || ')'
                   END

            WHEN load_type = 'PRVDEL_IDENTITY' THEN
                'DELETE FROM ' || target_table
                || ' WHERE ' || target_col
                || ' IN (SELECT ' || lookup_col
                || ' FROM ' || lookup_table || ')'
        END AS delete_query

    FROM signal_base
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.etl_signal AS s
    SET
        delete_query = g.delete_query,
        status       = 'PENDING',
        error_msg    = NULL,
        updated_dt   = LOCALTIMESTAMP
    FROM generated AS g
    WHERE s.signal_id = g.signal_id
      AND s.status = 'NEW'
      AND (
    g.delete_query IS NOT NULL
    OR (
        s.load_type = 'PRVDEL_SQL'
        AND NULLIF(BTRIM(s.sql_file_nm), '') IS NOT NULL
      )
    )

    RETURNING
        s.signal_id,
        s.load_type,
        s.src_db_nm,
        s.src_schema_nm,
        s.src_table_nm,
        s.delete_query,
        s.sql_file_nm,
        s.status
)
SELECT *
FROM updated
ORDER BY signal_id;

@concat(
    'UPDATE adfadm.etl_signal',
    ' SET status = ''DONE'',',
    ' error_msg = NULL,',
    ' updated_dt = LOCALTIMESTAMP',
    ' WHERE signal_id = ',
    string(item().signal_id),
    ' AND status = ''PENDING'';'
)

@concat(
    'UPDATE adfadm.etl_signal',
    ' SET status = ''FAILED'',',
    ' error_msg = ',
    decodeUriComponent('%27'),
    replace(
        take(
            string(activity('Run_Delete_Notebook').error.message),
            2000
        ),
        decodeUriComponent('%27'),
        decodeUriComponent('%27%27')
    ),
    decodeUriComponent('%27'),
    ', updated_dt = LOCALTIMESTAMP',
    ' WHERE signal_id = ',
    string(item().signal_id),
    ' AND status = ''PENDING'';'
)

baseParameters.sql_file_nm:
@if(
    empty(item().sql_file_nm),
    '',
    concat(
        '/Volumes/',
        item().src_db_nm, '/',
        item().src_schema_nm, '/',
        item().src_table_nm, '/',
        item().load_type, '/',
        item().sql_file_nm
    )
)
